crew_pilgrim.title: The Owner's Crew & the Ashen Pilgrim

dialogue: The Founders' Stone is cracked open. Ash-black boot prints lead to the harbour.
Someone has carved a burning eye into the rock: the sign of the Ashen Pilgrim.
Harbourmaster Odo
A knight in scorched armour... he took the Stone's seal and cut me down.
Harbourmaster Odo
He's hunting the old captain's crew. Only they know how the fire vents are sealed.
Harbourmaster Odo
My cache, up the hill: the captain's chart and the crew list. Find them before he does.
You take the captain's chart and the crew list.
Pip
I'm coming too! Cabin hand Pip, reporting!
First name on the list: the lighthouse keeper, Lantern Rock.

steps.text: Find the keeper at the Keeper's Hut
dialogue: Wren
You're not with him? Good. The knight smashed the lantern and took the keeper's lens.
Wren
There's lamp oil in the keeper's strongbox down by the pier. Help me relight it.

steps.text: Get lamp oil from the Keeper's Strongbox

dialogue: The Old Lantern flares back to life over the dark sea.
Wren
I can read the stars and the lights. With me aboard you can sail by night.
Wren
He's after the diver next. Saltglass Landing, on the coast.

steps.text: Find Brynn at the Glass-diver's Chest
dialogue: Brynn
They cracked the Singing Shards looking for me. Thanks for the rescue.
Brynn
I know every sea cave on this coast. I'll get your skiff in and out of them.
Brynn
Climb to the Lookout. You'll see where his ship went.
Through the haze, a black-sailed ship slips into the mouth of Glasswyrm Cavern.
Brynn
Glasswyrm Cavern. Only a skiff fits in there... and only a diver knows the way.
